_doc: Machine-readable tier capability matrix. Verified by packages/engine/tests/renderers/TierParityMatrix.test.ts. cell.state 'present' => regex MUST match in file; 'absent' => regex MUST NOT match (implementing a gap flips the test red, forcing a matrix update). absent cells need cell.class: 'gap' (+ finding id, fix wanted) | 'deliberate' (tier absence by design, reason required) | 'undecided' (needs owner decision). state 'na' = feature does not apply to the tier (reason required).

webgl1.reason: GL1 has no IBL; u_ambientColor stands in (comment in light_calc_pbr.frag.glsl)

webgl1.note: analytic Karis fit (EnvBrdfApproxGl1.test.ts); scene.brdfLUT upgrades to the real LUT via USE_BRDF_LUT when texture units are free (dropped first by the sampler budget)

webgl1.reason: glsl100 dialect has no shadow/array samplers (WebGLProgramCache._buildGlsl100 doc)
shared glass loops: dialects without shadow maps (glsl100) stay fully lit (header comment of glass_pbr_loops.frag.glsl)

webgpu.reason: WebGPU binding limits handled by SamplerBudget.ts at layout level

webgl2.reason: ADR 0059 tier variant: GL tiers have no GPU indirect; the CPU-cell fallback (InstanceFieldGL computing the frozen cull math on CPU + a direct drawElementsInstanced loop over ONE static 16-byte-record VBO, zero readback) replaces the GPU cull lane honestly (WebGLClusterCullPass precedent)

webgl1.reason: ADR 0059 tier variant: same CPU-cell fallback as WebGL2 via ANGLE_instanced_arrays + the unpacked f32 pose companion (fail-closed absent extension); no GPU culling or indirect draws on GL1

webgpu.reason: Not a divergence: the field pose resolves in the WebGPU pull vertex stage (field_pull.wgsl) and in the per-tier base vertex chunks on GL (base_vertex_header/main + web_gl1/base.vert, USE_INSTANCE_FIELD variants of the same frozen decode)
